due_when.clears_when: A ticket left in expiry_prompted (or any other prompted state) can no longer suppress the sleeve indefinitely. Concretely, EITHER: (a) prompted states carry a TIMEOUT after which the ticket auto-resolves to `expired` and stops counting as outstanding -- observed by finding such an auto-resolution in the live prop_tickets table, not by reading the code; OR (b) a detector PAGES the operator when any ticket has been in a prompted state beyond a threshold AND tickets are being suppressed against it -- observed firing on a real instance. [!] CLEARING THE TWO CURRENT TICKETS RESOLVES THIS NOT AT ALL -- that is the incident, and it is already done. [!] THE SLEEVE TRADING AGAIN IS NOT EVIDENCE EITHER: it will trade again the moment the jam clears, which says nothing about the next jam. [!] A GREEN TEST CLEARS NOTHING: the condition is a prompt a human did not answer, which a harness cannot reach. [!] AND DO NOT 'FIX' THIS BY MAKING THE RETICKET CHECK IGNORE expiry_prompted -- that check exists to stop duplicate tickets going to a human executor, and disabling it would trade a silent outage for silent double-placement on a real-money prop account. The fix belongs in the ticket's own lifecycle.
